item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: At lunchtime in her school in Pune, Meera sees her friend Arjun take a large serving of rice and dal and then throw half of it into the bin. Meera wants to explain why wasting this food is wrong. Which reason best connects avoiding food waste with the effort of farmers and community members?

options.A: Food should not be wasted because farmers, transporters and shopkeepers all spend time and effort bringing it from the farm to our plates.
options.B: Food left on the plate is only a personal matter, so throwing it away does not affect farmers or anyone else in the community.
options.C: It is acceptable to waste food that is cheap, because cheap food requires very little effort to produce and deliver.
options.D: Food waste cannot be avoided, so taking only as much food as one needs makes no real difference.
